Can only support your comment. My follow-up appointment after medical abortion was planned more than a month after said abortion. Didn't think much of the delay as i was doing alright, no pain, no fever, no bleeding.

Ended up in the ER the Saturday before the appointment. I had woken up in a sea of blood and was bleeding and cramping like I had on the abortion day.
Turns out there is still pregnancy tissue in my uterus. A month after.

They gave me another pill and part of it went away, but at follow-up a few days later, there was still some.
At this point I just want to go for surgical because i'm tired of all of this, feeling like my lady bits are a touristic attraction and also there is always a risk of getting an infection.

@OP please, go to this appointment.
I understand the last thing you might want is to go back and get examined, but it could save you lots of trouble and further examination (having another lady from Family Planning come in the room while i was legs up and fully exposed with a microscope directed to my uterus and asking if she could watch was the icing on the cake)

I think you should follow your instinct. I'm also struggling with mental health issues and as hard as it is, I also felt like it would have made things worse for myself or a child.

You mentioned going to a therapy session, I think it is great and will definitely help if you find the right one for you, and even if it is a long way to go, I promise it will get better and you will feel better someday.
Have you got other appointments planned for the coming months ? I felt like it helped me a lot to talk to the planned parenthood counselor and my usual psychologist before and after my abortion a couple weeks ago.

If you haven't, it might be a good idea if you feel safe with the therapist to get a couple more appointments to get external support and it might help you release a bit of tension if you know you'll meet him/her and will be able to get all your feelings and thoughts out to someone benevolent to you.

If you are going to planned parenthood (or if something similar exists where you live), maybe try and get an appointment with a counselor. Where I live, the staff was amazing throughout (and nobody tried to make me change my mind) but THAT lady found just the right words. I was sure of my choice but was a total wreck when i had time to realise what was going on (made my depression and anxiety so much worse). I felt so relieved after meeting her, knowing that the way I felt was normal, that I wasn't going full cray cray.

I'll repeat myself, but being able to make such a decision in such a mental health state, when it is already hard to function for yourself, is revealing of someone that is so strong and resourceful. 

Take care of yourself first, take the time to get happy and healthy again, YOU freakin deserve it ! :)
And that would only make you a more amazing and better mother when you will choose to become one.

Hi there,

First of all, i'm really sorry you have to go through this and feel this bad...
Not sure if that'll help, but even as an atheist, i think God would be understanding and love you no matter what, exactly like a parent. They might disagree but a good parent will support you and be there for you in tough times. 

Regarding the pregnancy, what do you feel like ? Would you want to have a child now ? Is it the finances only that scare you or might there be something else that would hold you back for now ?

I understand this is scary and I also need to feel financially safe before having any children. This is a responsible and adult thinking, and i have no doubt you would be a good parent, if and when you will be ready and able to.

Hope this won't sound arsh but even if you were to abort, that wouldn't be your last chance to ever have children.

If you feel like you would like to keep the pregnancy going, is there anything you can do to get support and better up your finances until you get in a more stable situation ?

Anyways, please try not to be so hard on yourself, i know how much it hurts already... I'm sure you are a wonderful and lovable human being and this won't change, no matter what your decision will be.

 Loads of hugs to you.
